gds.description: Build and audit GOV.UK-compliant services: GOV.UK Design System components, patterns and styles, plus WCAG 2.2 AA accessibility and the public sector accessibility regulations.

shadcn.description: Build, audit, and preview modern web apps with shadcn/ui components on Radix UI primitives and Tailwind CSS, meeting WCAG 2.2 AA accessibility. The default design system for net-new SME and startup web apps.

mui.description: Build, audit, and preview Material Design interfaces in the app's own framework (Svelte SMUI/m3-svelte, React @mui/material): the shared Material system (colour, type, spacing, elevation, theming) and component inventory, plus WCAG 2.2 AA accessibility for consumer and general-purpose web apps.

carbon.description: Build and audit enterprise, data-heavy B2B interfaces with the IBM Carbon Design System: Carbon components (React and Web Components), patterns, IBM Design Language styles and tokens, plus WCAG 2.2 AA accessibility and an axe-based conformance baseline.

auth.description: The default auth pack: end-user sign-up and sign-in for a delivered app, backed by an Amazon Cognito user pool. Ships templated files (pool and public client, the API's token check and GET /api/me, the sign-in, sign-up, confirm-code and reset screens) that the platform renders into a new BYOA app's first commit, and a skill for what each build still writes. Self-sign-up is on by default; email verification is required.

docs.description: Author an app's documentation with three authoritative frameworks: Diátaxis (the four documentation modes), the C4 model (software architecture diagrams), and arc42 (the 12-section architecture template). The first-party required-documentation capability skills.

web-svelte.description: The web-framework plugin for SvelteKit: a static SPA build, file routing, the shell that hosts providers, the route guard and the nav, error, 404 and offline pages, a small API client, and the web side of the local run contract.

api-go.description: The api-runtime plugin: a Go HTTP server skeleton with request logging and correlation ids, a middleware chain, routes and paging, a health route, an OpenAPI contract and the local test issuer, behind the api.middleware and api.routes slots.

test-playwright.description: The test-harness plugin: a Playwright journey harness with a watched browser context, one sign-in for the suite and local test identities, fixtures that clean up after themselves, an axe WCAG 2.2 A/AA audit, and a read-only CI workflow.

deploy-byoa-aws.description: The deploy-target plugin for a customer's own AWS account: Terraform rendered from albitor.yaml (CloudFront and S3 for the site, API Gateway and a Lambda for the API, DynamoDB tables, alarms, optional DNS) from versioned modules, the CI and deploy workflows, and the stale state-lock guard.

deploy-hosted.description: The deploy-target plugin for the hosted lane: no infrastructure in the repository, the platform compiles albitor.yaml and deploys it. Ships the managed CI workflow that checks the manifest and builds and tests the API and the web app.

data-dynamodb.description: The data-store plugin: a Store interface for the Go API over one DynamoDB table (string pk and sk, revisions, cursor paging), the in-memory fake for local runs and tests, the data-store@1 conformance suite, and the services.tables fragment. No Terraform: the deploy target realises the table.

client-online.description: The client-data plugin for online-only apps: TanStack Query for Svelte behind the web.providers slot, one shared query client with a sane retry policy, API query helpers, and loading, offline, error and empty states.

client-offline.description: The client-data plugin for offline-first apps: @albitor/sync, an IndexedDB store per signed-in person, an outbox that replays writes when the network returns, tombstones for deletions, a guarded single-flight sync, and a status line.

kit-shadcn.description: The component-kit plugin for Svelte: the styled shell pieces (app shell, nav, forms, tables, dialogs, toasts, empty states) in the shadcn style on Bits UI, themed by one set of colour tokens that pass WCAG 2.2 AA contrast in light and dark.

auth-cognito.description: The auth plugin for the default profile: Amazon Cognito sign-up and sign-in. The API verifies tokens and serves GET /api/me and the sign-in calls (managed, standard library only), the web side keeps a provider-independent session and a route guard, and the sign-in, sign-up, confirm, reset and sign-out screens are seeded per kit. It declares services.auth; the local issuer comes from api-go.

auth-none.description: The auth plugin for an app with no sign-in: a stub identity seam for the Go API in which every request acts for one fixed owner, so a handler written against it works unchanged under a real sign-in. No screens, no middleware, no routes, and no requirements, so a web-only profile composes it too.

kit-carbon.description: The component-kit plugin for Svelte in the IBM Carbon style: the styled shell pieces (UI shell with side nav, forms, tables, dialogs, toasts, empty states) on carbon-components-svelte, in Carbon's white and Gray 100 themes, which pass WCAG 2.2 AA contrast. Carbon is not themeable by a visual-language plugin.
